jyutping: jat1 jat6 sik6 gei2 do1 ci3
usage: The phrase '一日食幾多次' is used to ask about the frequency of taking medicine in one day.
You can use it to clarify how many doses of a medicine should be taken daily.
It functions as a noun phrase and often appears in questions about medication schedules.
This phrase is common at pharmacies or doctor consultations when discussing treatment plans.
It literally means 'how many times eat in a day,' referring to medicine intake frequency.
